title: Reinstated Monthly Installment — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Recovery Manual
content:
**Clause.** On Benefit Overpayment Accounts, the reinstated monthly installment is the overpayment's balance divided by the classification's maximum plan months, rounded up to the cent and never less than the classification's minimum monthly payment. The balance is the overpayment's balance due at the time of reinstatement.

**Terms.**

- *Balance*: the balance due shown on the overpayment record when the plan is reinstated, across all its components.
- *Reinstatement months*: the months over which the balance is spread, which are the classification's maximum plan months from the plan terms. The reinstatement months are never fewer than one.
- *Rounded up to the cent*: any fraction of a cent raises the amount to the next whole cent; an amount already in whole cents stays as it is.
- *Minimum*: when the rounded amount is below the classification's minimum monthly payment from the plan terms, the installment is that minimum.

**Order of the calculation.** The balance is divided by the reinstatement months; the result is rounded up to the cent; the higher of that amount and the minimum monthly payment is the reinstated installment.

## Worked examples on hypothetical balances

| Classification (plan terms) | Balance due | Division | Rounded up | Minimum | Reinstated installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense (36 months, USD 50.00) | USD 2,000.00 | 55.5555… | USD 55.56 | USD 50.00 | USD 55.56 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense (36 months, USD 50.00) | USD 900.00 | 25.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 50.00 | USD 50.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error (48 months, USD 25.00) | USD 3,000.00 | 62.50 | USD 62.50 | USD 25.00 | USD 62.50 |
